annotations.exact_quote: Subspace clustering aims to cluster unlabeled samples into multiple groups by implicitly seeking a subspace to fit each group.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确以子空间聚类为研究任务，目标是将无标样本按潜在子空间分组。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a novel subspace clustering method -- deeP subspAce clusteRing with sparsiTY prior (PARTY) -- based on a new deep learning architecture.
annotations.reason_zh: 提出基于新深度学习架构的深度子空间聚类方法，学习非线性潜在表示并用于聚类划分。

annotations.exact_quote: PARTY incorporates a prior sparsity information into the hidden representation learning to preserve the sparse reconstruction relation over the whole data set.
annotations.reason_zh: 在隐藏表示学习中注入先验稀疏信息，保持全体数据上的稀疏重构关系，属于稀疏表示机制。

abstentions.reason_zh: 仅提到将输入渐进变换到非线性潜在空间，未明确以维度压缩为目标或给出显式低维映射，证据不足。
